source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: After the examiner gives a direction, you are allowed enough time to check traffic and carry it out.
corrections.note: Statement is correct but printed on PDF page 22, not 21.

corrections.corrected_statement: When traveling through a roundabout stay to the right of the center island, let vehicles already in the roundabout have the right of way, do not stop unless it is the only way to avoid a crash, and do not change lanes or attempt to pass any vehicle.
corrections.note: Separated the stopping exception from the separate bans on changing lanes and passing.

corrections.corrected_statement: The shoulder check flips with the direction of the lane change: before moving out to pass you look over the left shoulder, and before moving back in you look over the right one.
corrections.note: The left shoulder check is stated on page 39 not the cited page 40.

corrections.corrected_statement: Keep a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead of you as described in chapter eight.
corrections.note: The page only refers to chapter eight and does not name a spacing method.

corrections.corrected_statement: The railroad advance warning sign is round, which sets it apart from the X-shaped crossbuck placed at the crossing itself.
corrections.note: The X-shaped crossbuck detail appears on page 53, not the cited page 52.

corrections.corrected_statement: If something overhangs the rear by more than five feet, the end must have a red flag or cloth at least sixteen inches square during the day and a red light from one half hour after sunset until one half hour before sunrise.
corrections.note: Replaced at night with the exact light period stated on the page.

corrections.corrected_statement: When towing another vehicle, the towline must keep the vehicles within fifteen feet of each other and both vehicles must have lights on from one half hour after sunset until one half hour before sunrise.
corrections.note: Replaced at night with the exact light period stated on the page.

corrections.corrected_statement: For an intoxication related point suspension or revocation you must submit the reinstatement requirements listed on page seventy one.
corrections.note: Changed alcohol and drugs chapter to page seventy one as printed.

corrections.corrected_statement: Examples of state law violations that carry twelve points include leaving the scene of a traffic crash and a felony involving a motor vehicle and obtaining a driver license by misrepresentation and operating a vehicle with a suspended or revoked driver license.
corrections.note: Changed exhaustive list to examples as printed.

corrections.corrected_statement: School bus suspensions run 90, 90 and then 180 days, unlike the point suspensions of 30, 60 and 90 days.
corrections.note: Point suspension periods are printed on page seventy five.

corrections.corrected_statement: For failing to stop for a school bus the first offense results in a court ordered suspension of ninety days or as designated by the court and the second offense within five years results in ninety days and the third or subsequent offense within five years results in one hundred eighty days.
corrections.note: Corrected to show second offense stays at ninety days.
